name: PokeBag Plus
description: Splits the bag into four pockets -- ITEMS, BALLS, KEY ITEMS and TM/HM -- paged with Left and Right. Keeps the vanilla 20 slot limit and acquisition order.

optional_imports.name: Pokemon FireRed (U) ROM
optional_imports.description: Optional. Your own FireRed ROM, v1.0 or v1.1, used only to show item icons beside the bag. LeafGreen works too.

optional_imports.name: Pokemon LeafGreen (U) ROM
optional_imports.description: Optional. Your own LeafGreen ROM, v1.0 or v1.1, used only to show item icons beside the bag. FireRed works too.
